I can’t{NEWLINE}take the little one out to sea anymore.{SCROLL}So I’d like to entrust it to you.{SCROLL}Will you take it with you on your{NEWLINE}travels?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 以往每年都会有巴大蝴{NEWLINE}飞到这里来交配产卵,{CLEAR}但是最近飞来的巴大蝴明显少了许多,{CLEAR}是因为它们都在别处安家了吗……
strings.en: Every year, Butterfree used to fly{NEWLINE}here to mate and lay their eggs.{CLEAR}But lately, far fewer{CLEAR}of them have been coming.{CLEAR}Have they all made new{CLEAR}homes somewhere else...?

strings.zh: 每年巴大蝴都会飞来这里交配产卵,{NEWLINE}看到它们在一起孕育出新生命,{CLEAR}仿佛是看到了清晨初升的太阳,{CLEAR}感觉整个世界都充满了生机和希望。
strings.en: Every year, Butterfree fly here to{NEWLINE}mate and lay their eggs.{CLEAR}Watching them bring new{CLEAR}life into the world is like{CLEAR}seeing the sun rise at dawn.{CLEAR}It makes the whole world feel full of{CLEAR}life and hope.

strings.en: It’s you! Thank you for saving us on{NEWLINE}the S.S. Anne.{CLEAR}Thanks to you, I got to see the{CLEAR}beautiful sights of Alto Mare.{CLEAR}This is a small token of my thanks.{CLEAR}Please accept it.
